results.title: Who is bhai Nirmal Singh Khalsa?
results.snippet: Bhai Sahib was a highly regarded ragi with knowledge of all 31 Raags of Guru Granth Sahib. For services in the field of arts, Bhai Nirmal Singh Khalsa was awarded the Padma Shri, the fourth highest civilian award in the Republic of India, in 2009. He was the first Hazoori Ragi to receive this award.
